task: Prevent Koala recovery views from implying that init_check_repair fallback or a discovered external story authorizes implementation continuation.
outcome: A user runs `koala session_brief` on a story that used init_check_repair and sees: `INIT fallback warning` plus `manual fallback attestation, not independent reviewer approval`; the same output says later PLAN/DEV/REVIEW/TEST gates remain required and implementation needs explicit user/project authorization.
facts: B-4f98 showed that fallback can be valid while still misleading an agent into cross-project continuation.
init_check_repair already writes initCheckAttestation=fallback and initCheckFallback in story_get.
Current session_brief next-step wording can say Resume: cd <worktree> without surfacing the fallback/manual-attestation boundary.
The fix should not alter init-check signature semantics or lifecycle gate acceptance.
constraints: Do not add a new hard blocker for valid fallback stories.
Do not weaken independent reviewer detection or init-check tamper protection.
Keep the change to user-facing warnings and smoke coverage.
Do not touch authority evidence, runner, or non-init lifecycle behavior except rendering guidance.
